reminder: Screening support only. A clinician decides.
prototype_note: Research prototype, not a medical device.
signin_body: Use the team account Nana Yaw gave you.
signin_failed: That email or password did not work. Check them and try again.
no_clinic: Your account has no clinic yet. Ask Nana Yaw to add you to the demo clinic.
backend_missing: This copy of the app is not connected to the team backend. Results will not be saved.
backend_required: This copy of the app is not connected to the team backend, so it cannot be used for screening. Tell Nana Yaw.
home_title: Screen a chest X-ray for TB
home_body: Photograph the film or upload the image. It takes about a minute.
model_ready: TB model ready on this phone
model_ready_body: Runs on the phone. The image stays on this phone unless the person agrees to share it with a referral.
model_demo: Demo stand-in loaded, not the TB model
model_demo_body: Results in demo mode are made up. Use it to try the screens only.
model_loading_body: This happens once. Keep the app open.
take_photo: Take a photo of the film
under15_title: This check is for people aged 15 and over
under15_body: Do not use it for children's X-rays. Follow your usual care for this child.
not_ready_pending: The team has not set the decision thresholds for this model yet, so the app will not show results.
not_ready_invalid: The thresholds file does not match this model. Tell Kweku before screening.
not_ready_model: The TB model could not be loaded or did not pass its file check. Tell Nana Yaw.
checking_body: Everything runs on this phone. The image stays on this phone unless the person agrees to share it with a referral.
retake_title_too_small: Retake: the image is too small to read
retake_body_too_small: Move closer so the film fills the frame, or upload the full-size image.
retake_body_blank: Make sure the whole film is in view and in focus, then take the photo again.
retake_title_too_dark: Retake: the image is too dark to read
retake_body_too_dark: Hold the film against a bright window or light box, then take the photo again.
retake_title_too_bright: Retake: the image is too bright to read
retake_body_too_bright: Move the phone away from the light or shade the light box, then take the photo again.
retake_title_not_xray: Retake: this does not look like a chest X-ray
retake_body_not_xray: Photograph only the X-ray film, filling the frame, with nothing else in view.
retake_title_glare: Retake: there is a bright reflection on the film
retake_body_glare: Tilt the phone or step to one side until the reflection is gone, then take the photo again.
retake_body_blurred: Hold the phone still, tap the screen to focus, then take the photo again.
retake_title_not_framed: Retake: the film does not fill the picture
retake_body_not_framed: Move closer so the whole X-ray fills the picture, with nothing else in view, then take the photo again.
retake_no_result: No result was made from this image.
error_body: The image could not be checked. No result was made. Try again with another photo.
message_refer_now: High risk on this scan. Refer for a TB confirmation test.
message_unsure: Not sure. Retake the image, or refer.
message_low_risk: Low risk on this scan. This does not rule out disease. If symptoms continue, test or refer.
refer_confirm: Refer for a TB confirmation test, following your clinic's process.
not_saved: Not saved to the team backend. The result above is unchanged.
dev_score: Development build only: TB score {p}. Low risk below {so}, Refer now at {ref} or above. Not shown in the real app.
monitor_title: Is the TB model still seeing what it was trained on?
monitor_none: No records yet. The first screening after deploy appears here. Each record holds numbers only: no image, no name, no patient ID.
monitor_failed: Could not load records. Check that you are signed in.
kpi_quality_note: size, blank, exposure, colour, glare, blur or framing
kpi_last_note: a silent feed is an alert too
score_ref_pending: Validation reference not loaded yet; live results only.
drift_formula: PSI = Σ (live − train) × ln(live ÷ train) over 10 bins. 0.2 or more is the alert line.
drift_pending: Training reference not loaded yet. Showing the live median instead of PSI.
drift_aspect_ratio_why: The shape shortcut found in training (ADR-16).
drift_edge_energy_why: Texture tracked the TB score in Shenzhen.
drift_mean_brightness_why: Photos of film against digital files; room light.
drift_width_why: An upstream format change, the stale-feed case.
zone_mix_note: A shift here with steady inputs points at the model or the thresholds, not the images.
rules_demo_draft: Referral rules are a demo draft. A clinician has not signed them off yet.
refer_not_saved: This result was not saved, so it cannot be sent as a referral yet. Refer following your clinic's process.
refer_no_directory: The facility list is not on this phone yet. Connect to the internet once, then try again.
distance_from_clinic: Distances are from your clinic, in a straight line. Roads may be longer.
distance_from_phone: Distances are from this phone, in a straight line. Roads may be longer.
location_unknown: Your location is not known, so facilities are listed by name.
location_denied: Could not get this phone's location. Distances stay as before.
none_in_reach: No facility within 100 km has {services}. Below: the nearest with some of them, and the nearest with all of them. Call before sending the person.
refer_unfiltered: The referral rules could not be used for this result. All facilities are listed by distance. Call to check they can help.
initials_hint: Ask the person first. Their initials go on the referral and are shown to {name}. Type the first letter of each name, for example K A M. Names are not kept.
initials_preview: The code will start with {initials}. These initials are shown to {name}. Names are not kept.
refer_failed: Not sent. Check the signal and try again. Nothing was lost.
slip_give_code: Give this code to the person. The facility will ask for it.
services_never_confirmed: Services never confirmed. Check by phone first.
services_stale: Services last confirmed {days} days ago. Check by phone first.
lookup_missing: No referral to this facility has that code, or it has expired. Check the code with the person.
lookup_locked: Too many tries. Wait 15 minutes, then try again.
inbox_offline: Check the signal, then try again. Nothing was lost.
row_not_arrived: Not arrived after 7 days. Follow up with the person.
detail_screening_note: This is a screening result from the referring clinic. It needs a confirmation test.
outcome_question: What did the confirmation test show?
action_close_not_arrived: Close: the person did not come
advance_failed: Not saved. Check the signal and try again.
image_consent_label: The person agrees to share the X-ray image, and the heatmap when there is one, with {name}
image_consent_hint: Ask first. Without this, only the result and the code (with any initials) are sent.
image_not_shared: The X-ray image was not shared.
image_load_failed: Could not load the image. Tap to try again.
image_alt: Chest X-ray image shared with this referral
image_no_receiver_key: Not shared: this facility has not set up image sharing
image_receiver_no_key: This facility has not set up image sharing yet, so only the result and the code can be sent.
image_no_key: This image was not shared with this facility's key, so it cannot be opened here.
heatmap_caption: Coloured areas raised the TB screening score the most. It is not a finding. Read the image yourself.
unlock_hint: Images are locked so only this facility can open them. Type the passphrase once on this phone.
unlock_wrong: That passphrase did not work. Ask your facility admin.
setup_body: Choose a passphrase for this facility. Staff type it once on each phone to open shared X-ray images. If it is lost, images already shared cannot be opened. Store it safely.
setup_mismatch: The two passphrases do not match.
setup_failed: Could not set up image sharing. Check the signal and try again.
setup_ask_admin: This facility cannot receive X-ray images yet. Ask your facility admin to set up image sharing.
amb_emergency: In an emergency, call now. An app request does not replace a call.
amb_no_phone: No phone number is listed for {name}. Use your clinic's usual contact.
amb_reason_q: Why can the person not travel safely on their own?
amb_offline: No signal, so the request was not sent and is not waiting to send. Call {name} now.
amb_failed: The request was not sent. Call the facility now.
amb_already_open: A request for this referral is already open. Call the facility to check on it.
amb_status_requested: Request sent to {name}. Waiting for them to see it. If nobody sees it in 10 minutes, call them.
amb_status_dispatched: {name} is sending an ambulance. About {eta} minutes.
amb_status_cannot_send: {name} cannot send an ambulance. Call them to arrange transport.
amb_not_seen: Not seen yet after 10 minutes. Call them now.
amb_cannot_why: Why not, so the clinic can act
amb_notify_body: {n} new ambulance request. Open Referrals to answer.
facility_admins_only: This page is for facility admins.
facility_never_confirmed: Services have never been confirmed. Referring clinics are told to call first.
facility_confirmed_ago: Services last confirmed {days} days ago. After 90 days, referring clinics are told to call first.
facility_services_q: What can this facility do today?
facility_save_failed: Not saved. Check the signal and try again.
stats_note: Counts only, no names or codes. Counts from 1 to 4 show as “fewer than 5” so no one person can be picked out.
stats_confirmed: Confirmed by test, of those tested
urgency_draft: (demo draft rule, not yet signed off by a clinician)
outcome_not_confirmed_note: This does not rule out disease. If symptoms continue, test or refer.
amb_urgent: This may be an emergency. Call {name} now, before sending this request.
amb_alert: Ambulance request for {code} not seen by {name} after 10 minutes. Call them now.
hint_age: Choose the age band, then take the photo
hint_ready: Fill the frame with the film
welcome_body: Check chest X-rays on this phone, even with no signal.
signin_offline_note: Sign in once with internet. After that, screening works with no signal.
help_step1: Ask your facility admin for a TriageLens account.
help_step2: They add you to your clinic and send your email.
help_step3: Sign in here once with internet.
close_confirm: Close this referral? It can't be reopened.
xray_caption: The X-ray as the referring clinic took it.
setup_lost: If the passphrase is lost, shared images can't be opened.
beds_low_blocked: Only {n} beds free. Referral off. Call them.
beds_stale: Beds updated {h} h ago. Call first.
beds_save_failed: Beds not saved. Check the connection and try again.
beds_low_note: At {max} or fewer free beds, other clinics can't refer here. They are asked to call you.
beds_none_note: Set the total to 0 if this facility has no beds. Referrals are never blocked then.
map_none: Nothing has every service you ticked, or the name is not in the list.
map_svg_label: Drawn map of Ghana with facilities. Use the list to choose a facility.
map_low_flag: Few beds free. Referrals can't be sent here now. Call them.
map_straight_line: Distances are straight lines. Roads may be longer.
cases_search_label: Find a case by its code
cases_search_hint: The code is on the result screen, for example TL-7K3MPQ.
cases_count: {n} cases on this phone, newest first.
cases_empty: Each screening is saved here as soon as the photo is taken, even with no signal.
cases_no_match: No code starts with {q}. Check the code on the result and try again.
cases_unavailable: Storage is blocked or full. Screening still works, but nothing is kept on the phone.
case_no_result_retake: No result. The image did not pass the quality check.
case_no_result_error: No result. The image could not be checked.
case_no_result_captured: No result. The screening stopped before the model finished.
notes_hint: Do not write names, phone numbers, ID numbers, dates of birth or addresses.
notes_failed: Notes were not saved. Try again.
result_case_failed: This result was not saved on this phone. Write the result down.
inbox_pick_body: Its details and the next step show here.
inbox_empty_received_body: When a clinic refers someone here, it shows in this list. If a person brings a code, type it above.
inbox_empty_sent_body: When a result says Refer now or Not sure, choose Refer to send it to a facility. It shows here.
cases_unavailable_title: Cases can't be saved on this phone
cases_pick_body: Its result, versions and notes show here.
case_missing_title: This case is not on the phone
case_missing_body: It may have been cleared. Go back to the list.
directory_missing_title: The facility list is not on this phone
directory_empty: Your admin adds facilities. Once they do, connect once and they show here.
refer_none_listed: No other facility is in the list yet. Refer following your clinic's process and call ahead.
stats_offline: Check the signal, then open this page again.
stats_empty: Numbers show once your clinic sends or receives referrals.
refer_no_beds: Not sent: {name} just became nearly full. Call them, or choose another facility.
refer_all_full: Every facility shown is nearly full. Call one of them, or show all facilities.
